1. (Currently amended) A vehicle door comprising: a door outer panel defining an exterior surface of the vehicle door; a common door inner panel located inboard of the door outer panel and configured to mount door hardware, the common door inner panel having a periphery; and a panel extension extending around essentially all of the periphery of the common door inner panel, the panel extension being attached to the periphery of the common door inner panel via an inner panel-extension joint including fasteners, and attached to the door outer panel via an outer panel-extension joint that is not a hemmed joint, to secure the common door inner panel to the door outer panel.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently amended) The vehicle door of claim 1 wherein the inner panel-extension joint includes fasteners securing the panel extension to the common door inner panel.

4. (Currently amended) The vehicle door of claim 1 including at least one hinge that is mounted to the common door inner panel via a frame member.

5. (Currently amended) A vehicle door comprising: a door outer panel defining an exterior surface of the vehicle door; a common door inner panel located inboard of the door outer panel and configured to mount door hardware, the common door inner panel having a periphery; and a panel extension extending around essentially all of the periphery of the common door inner panel, the panel extension being attached to the periphery of the common door inner panel and attached to the door outer panel via an outer panel-extension joint that is not a hemmed joint to secure the common door inner panel to the door outer panel, wherein the common door inner panel is configured to be compatible with a plurality of different door outer panels and corresponding panel extensions, each panel extension being specifically configured to mate with its corresponding door outer panel.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein step (b) is further defined by attaching the panel extension to the door outer panel without hemming.
